examples.question_text: A lake has a surface area of $1.8\text{ km}^{2}$. An average of $14$ mm of rain falls on it. Find the increase in water volume in cubic metres, kilolitres and megalitres. Ignore runoff from surrounding land.

examples.solution_text:
$9600\text{ mm}=9.6\text{ m}$ and $7500\text{ mm}=7.5\text{ m}$.

$\begin{aligned}A&=lw\\&=9.6\times7.5\\&=72\text{ m}^{2}\end{aligned}$

$15\text{ mm}=0.015\text{ m}$.

$\begin{aligned}V&=Ah\\&=72\times0.015\\&=1.08\text{ m}^{3}\\&=1080\text{ L}\end{aligned}$

Use image : original $=1:600$ to scale each length.

$3.5\times600=2100\text{ cm}=21\text{ m}$.

$2\times600=1200\text{ cm}=12\text{ m}$.

$\begin{aligned}A&=lw\\&=21\times12\\&=252\text{ m}^{2}\end{aligned}$

$25\text{ mm}=0.025\text{ m}$.

$\begin{aligned}V&=Ah\\&=252\times0.025\\&=6.3\text{ m}^{3}\\&=6300\text{ L}\end{aligned}$

Scale the outer rectangle and the missing rectangle.

$5\times300=1500\text{ cm}=15\text{ m}$.

$4\times300=1200\text{ cm}=12\text{ m}$.

$2\times300=600\text{ cm}=6\text{ m}$.

Subtract the missing rectangle from the outer rectangle.

$\begin{aligned}A&=15\times12-6\times6\\&=180-36\\&=144\text{ m}^{2}\end{aligned}$

$18\text{ mm}=0.018\text{ m}$.

$\begin{aligned}V&=Ah\\&=144\times0.018\\&=2.592\text{ m}^{3}\\&=2.592\text{ kL}\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: A house roof has area $240\text{ m}^{2}$. Its average annual rainfall is $720$ mm, and $15\%$ of the rainfall is lost through inefficient collection. How much water can be collected annually, in kilolitres?
examples.solution_text:
$720\text{ mm}=0.72\text{ m}$.

$\begin{aligned}V&=Ah\\&=240\times0.72\\&=172.8\text{ m}^{3}\\&=172.8\text{ kL}\end{aligned}$

The collected fraction is $1-0.15=0.85$.

$\begin{aligned}V_{\text{collected}}&=172.8\times0.85\\&=146.88\text{ kL}\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: A roof has area $160\text{ m}^{2}$ and receives $900$ mm of rain annually. Collection losses are $10\%$. Town water costs $\$2.80$ per kilolitre. Find the annual saving if all collected rainwater replaces town water.

All rainfall on a roof of area $210\text{ m}^{2}$ flows into a rectangular tank with base dimensions $2$ m by $1.4$ m. During a storm, $16$ mm of rain falls. Find the rise in the tank's water level in centimetres. Assume the tank does not overflow.
examples.solution_text:
$16\text{ mm}=0.016\text{ m}$.

$\begin{aligned}V&=Ah\\&=210\times0.016\\&=3.36\text{ m}^{3}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}A_{\text{tank}}&=2\times1.4\\&=2.8\text{ m}^{2}\end{aligned}$

Use the collected volume and the tank's base area in $V=Ah$.

$\begin{aligned}3.36&=2.8h\\h&=\frac{3.36}{2.8}\\&=1.2\text{ m}\\&=120\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$
